title: Ghost hunters set to discover if riverside pub is haunted
excerpt: Gibraltar Gardens will be investigated by a team of ghost hunters in October who believe the pub along the River Wensum is haunted.
content:
One of Norwich's oldest pubs is set to come under paranormal scrutiny as a team of ghost hunters investigates its long-standing haunted reputation.

Sam Howett, Angel-Mae Howett, Darren Gowing and Wayne Yaxley will descend on Gibraltar Gardens in Heigham Street on October 16 from 8pm onwards to uncover the pub's supernatural secrets.

Gibraltar Gardens (Image: Submitted)

The four paranormal investigators will scour the 15th century site along the River Wensum armed with ghost-hunting equipment, including REM pods.

The ghost hunters are ready (Image: Submitted)

The team, known as Shadow Hunters UK, is particularly interested in communicating with the ghost of a young boy said to roam the premises.

Sam said: “A local told us about a young boy who died in the river centuries ago.

“It would be great to find some spirits that were customers from the pub years ago.

“We would like to find out what the building was used for before it became a pub.

Darren Gowing, Sam Howett and Wayne Yaxley (Image: Submitted)

The pub garden which overlooks the Wensum (Image: Submitted)

“We could be unlocking a treasure chest, or we could walk away with nothing.”

Another customer told the group a ghostly figure appeared behind them for a split second, only to vanish into thin air when they turned around.

“That got our spidy senses elevated,” she said.

“We would like to make contact with that spirit" she added.

Inside the pub (Image: Submitted)

The bar area (Image: Submitted)

The team has investigated other historic pubs across Norfolk, including the Bell Inn in Thetford, but were eager to turn their attention to a site in Norwich.

Sam said: “It's a 15th century site, one of the oldest pubs in the city.

“Its location, right by the river, appealed to us, there would have been lots of people on boats using the tavern.

“The manager of Gibraltar Gardens has agreed to work exclusively with us to explore the spiritual side of the pub a couple of times a year.”

The event has sold out but Shadow Hunters UK are set to scope out Carrow House in Norwich on October 31, with tickets still available on their website.
